summary: Marginal boating day. Winds 5–10 kt, light chop on the bay. Numerous storms likely, mostly afternoon and evening, with gusty downpours that can spike local seas and gusts fast. Rain around 62%. Run the pass and any Gulf legs early.
gulf_seas: 1 foot or less, then around 2 feet after midnight
source: NWS Tampa Bay, Coastal Waters Forecast (CWFTBW)
